status: UNFROZEN TEMPLATE - do not treat as a pre-registration until frozen
protocol: freeze-first: sha256 of this file is committed and pushed BEFORE any QPU job is submitted (precedent: docs/validation/BLIND_PREDICTION_2.frozen.json). Fill device fields at booking, then freeze. Thresholds and CHSH settings may NOT be edited after freeze.
framing_rule: Hardware calibrates or validates our simulator. Hardware never computes the chemistry. No sentence of the form 'the QPU produced X kJ/mol' is permitted.
what_this_cannot_do: FeMo-co active space (54 orbitals): out of reach - order 1e11 T gates, ~1e5 s at 1 us/cycle even fault-tolerant
The d=4, n=16 FBSC state: 4^16 = 2^32 amplitudes, no known state-prep circuit; generic prep ~2^32 gates = ~430 s per shot at 0.1 us/gate
Any barrier in kJ/mol from hardware: smallest ladder rung is 14.7833 kJ/mol, chemical accuracy is 4.184 kJ/mol

budget.note: seconds are not the binding constraint; the reserve is for one re-run of any experiment that fails its threshold

rank_note: value-per-second ordering and execution ordering differ on purpose: E1 is last by ratio and first in the block because E3 and E5 consume its measured channel as an input.

device.note: results are only reportable with vendor + device + date, because device parameters drift weekly

experiments.title: device channel calibration (T1 / T2 echo / readout / two-qubit RB)
circuits: T1: X, delay tau in 10 geometric points 10-300 us, measure; 4 qubits; 5000 shots/point
T2 echo: X, delay tau/2, X, delay tau/2, measure; 12 delays 5-150 us; 4 qubits; 5000 shots/point
readout: prepare |0> and X|0>, measure; 20000 shots each
2q RB: interleaved randomized benchmarking, 4 adjacent pairs, 25 depths 1-25, 2000 shots/depth/pair

fits.RB: F(m) = A*p^m + B with e2 = (1-p)(d-1)/d, d=4

experiments.success_threshold: all four fits chi2/dof < 3; T1 in [20,400] us; T2 in [10,300] us; T2 <= 2*T1; readout error in [0.1%,5%]; bootstrap 95% CI width < 20% of each value
experiments.failure_threshold: any chi2/dof > 5, any value outside its physical range, or T2 < 5 us -> abort the whole block and report the abort
experiments.claim_earned: measured T1, T2, readout error, two-qubit error for device D on date T; these replace the assumed coherence and protection inputs to our simulator
experiments.claim_not_earned: that coherence=0.876241 or protection=0.995139 is validated; that any barrier is validated

experiments.title: CHSH with the settings from our own LP LHV-exclusion search
circuits: H(q0), CNOT(q0,q1), RZ(-2a) on q0, RZ(-2b) on q1, measure - for the 4 (ai,bj) combinations
experiments.settings_source: docs/artifacts/quantum_likeness/ LP-optimal angles, copied verbatim and NOT re-optimised after seeing data
experiments.estimator: E = (N_same - N_diff)/(N_same + N_diff); S = E00 + E01 + E10 - E11
experiments.inconclusive_band: 2.00 < S_meas < 2.60 is pre-declared inconclusive, not a success
experiments.claim_earned: our LP-optimal settings are physically realisable; measured S and measured Tsirelson deficit; our analytic channel model reproduces measured S within a stated band
experiments.claim_not_earned: any upgrade of the quantum-likeness claim (already classically proven); no loophole-free claim

experiments.title: does the exact-zero braid invariance survive measurement (transfer gap)
circuits: 4-strand braid word (length 20) as a CNOT/swap network on 4 qubits
isotopy arm: insert k in {0,2,4,8,16,40} cancelling kink pairs with compiler optimisation DISABLED
control arm: insert k genuine crossing flips (element changes)
measure: mirror-circuit survival (U then U-dagger) + element error (shots outside expected permutation support)
experiments.compiler_requirement: optimization_level=0; PRINT AND CHECK that compiled depths differ across k. If depths are identical the run is VOID and must be reported as void.

predictions.P1: element error grows with k on the isotopy arm; e(40) - e(0) <= 0.05
predictions.P2: mirror fidelity on the isotopy arm drops >= 0.15 from k=0 to k=40 (our analytic model predicts 0.967 -> 0.844, drop 0.123)
predictions.P3: control-arm element error >= 10x isotopy-arm at every k >= 2

experiments.success_threshold: P1 AND P2 AND P3 hold with non-overlapping 95% CIs
experiments.failure_threshold: any of P1-P3 refuted, OR compiled depths identical across k (void)
experiments.claim_earned: under a measured channel, the word-level invariant degrades by X while state fidelity degrades by Y; the classical exact-zero claim transfers with a measured gap
experiments.claim_not_earned: topological protection, anyon braiding, non-abelian statistics, fault tolerance. No anyons exist on a transmon.

experiments.title: is the d=3 / d=4 qudit row representable on device
experiments.availability_flag: UNCERTAIN - qudit (d>=3) access is not a supported cloud API on major providers at time of writing; may require pulse-level control. Verify at booking.
circuits: 4 transmons as qutrits/ququarts; prepare (|0>+|1>)/sqrt2, (|0>+|2>)/sqrt2, (|0>+|1>+|2>)/sqrt3 and d=4 analogues with SU(3)/SU(4) pulses
read out 3 (4) levels via |2>->|1> shelving plus a second readout pulse
experiments.success_threshold: SPAM-corrected 3-outcome assignment fidelity >= 0.90 AND single-qudit qutrit process fidelity >= 0.95
experiments.claim_earned: d=4 encoding is available on device class C at measured fidelity F; the d=4 row's dimension is not fiction
experiments.claim_not_earned: that the d=4 row's 100.7657 kJ/mol means anything physically

experiments.title: measured depth-decay curve replacing the analytic NISQ table
circuits: random Clifford layers of depth D in {1,2,4,6,8,10} on n in {8,16,24,32} qubits, followed by the exact inverse (mirror)
both a linear chain and a heavy-hex-like coupling map, so the r2 connectivity factor is measured not assumed
experiments.success_threshold: >= 80% of (n,D) points inside the 95% band of our model re-evaluated with E1's measured channel parameters
experiments.failure_threshold: systematic deviation in the optimistic direction (model predicts higher fidelity than measured) at more than half the points -> the published domination table must be weakened
experiments.claim_earned: the depth axis of VALIDATION_BENCHMARK.md is measured for device D on date T; the domination claim over our depth-independent core holds with measured numbers
experiments.claim_not_earned: any speedup, advantage, or fault tolerance

experiments.title: chemical-accuracy floor: the negative experiment, run on purpose
circuits: 4-qubit (2-site) Heisenberg/Hubbard dimer standing in for the [2Fe-2S] singlet-triplet gap (the BLIND_PREDICTION_2 target)
fixed hardware-efficient ansatz, 20 parameter sets from a pre-computed classical optimisation, 10000 shots each
readout-error mitigation by calibration-matrix inversion; reference = exact diagonalisation of a 16x16 matrix
experiments.success_threshold: run completes and epsilon = |E_measured - E_exact| is reported with a bootstrap CI
experiments.expectation: epsilon in [5,50] kJ/mol after mitigation (speculation, stated so it can fail)
experiments.surprise_clause: if epsilon <= 4.184 kJ/mol at 4 qubits, publish as a HIT at the top of the doc - chemical accuracy has been demonstrated on hardware for small weakly-correlated molecules, so this is possible
experiments.failure_threshold: no fitted energy, or CI width > 20 kJ/mol -> report inconclusive at this shot budget
experiments.claim_earned: measured NISQ energy error epsilon at 4 qubits, expressed as a fraction of the smallest ladder rung (14.7833 kJ/mol) and of chemical accuracy (4.184 kJ/mol)
experiments.claim_not_earned: anything about FeMo-co; the 4-qubit to 54-orbital extrapolation is interpretation only
